Weather Update and Dress-Down Recommendation — Metro Manila

Good day, ABC team.

As of Thursday, September 3, 2026, Metro Manila is experiencing thunderstorm. Current conditions are 29.4°C (feels like 33.6°C), with 77% humidity. Winds are approximately 27.2 km/h, with gusts up to 74.5 km/h. Today’s forecast calls for thunderstorms, around 16.9 mm of rain, gusts up to 74.5 km/h, and temperatures from 26.1°C to 29.4°C.

No verified PAGASA advisory was available from this automated check.

Given these severe weather conditions, employees should allow extra travel time and prioritize safety while commuting. Employees who need to report on-site may dress down in casual, comfortable, and weather-appropriate attire.

Stay safe and coordinate with your immediate supervisor regarding your schedule.

Thank you and best regards,
Human Resources
